subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) He earned a lot of money from his dynamite business. (b) This award was named after Alfred Nobel. (c) He was an Engineer. (d) Dr. Alfred Nobel was born on 21 October, 1833 at Stockholm, Sweden. (e) So, it was called the "Nobel Prize." (f) He invented dynamite after some years of joining his father's company. (g) This award was also given for setting up peace in the world. (h) He undertook a plant to give an award for encouraging the creative work.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
